obligations.description: Server write-side guard on CGameServer::BroadcastGameData (0x50f30 Win / 0x0012f260 Linux), SendGameData (0x509f0 / 0x0012f510), BroadcastFilter (0x50af0), BroadcastTeam (0x50cf0), and Linux CHostServer: when byte[0] == 0x60 (GAME_CMD_KILL_MESSAGE) and bufferLen >= 12 && bufferLen < 12 + 4 * byte[11], clamp byte[11] = (bufferLen - 12) / 4, log [NATIVE-GUARD][KILL-PACKET-CLAMP], and increment KillPacketClampCount.

Verified CGameServer::BroadcastGameData (0x50f30 Win / 0x0012f260 Linux) feeds BOTH CReplayManager::WriteGameData (0x510c9, 0x510ee) and CHostServer::BroadcastGameData (0x51105) plus delayed queue [rbp+0x6c0]; Linux native guard hooks game-x86_64-server.so and libk2-x86_64-server.so without libstdc++ dependencies.

Verified cgame_x64.dll CClientGame::ProcessGameData (0xd7690, case 0x60 @ 0xdc02c-0xdc6ba) uses a dynamic std::vector<int> ([rsp+0xf30]) with no fixed stack cap and supports 5..9+ assists safely; added CPacket remaining-byte bounds clamp in cgame ProcessGameData hook so legacy 28-byte kill5 .honreplay files never over-read 4 bytes. macOS parity documented in macos_native_guard.mm.

Swept all 139 IBuffer ctor sites (IAT 0x648308) and FUN_1804f3e00 in game_shared_x64.dll: confirmed CBufferFixed<28> at 0x5758e1 (KillNotifyHelper 0x575460/0x5761a0 Win, 0x00d1e3b0 Linux) is the sole team-size buffer overflow. Detoured KillNotifyHelper to collect deduplicated ascending IUnitEntity::m_iOwnerClientNumber (+0x6d4 Win / +0x6bc Linux) when assists >= 5 and swap a 128-byte K2IBufferLayout in BroadcastGameData (up to 29 assists), keeping Stage 1A clamp active and pairing with kill5..kill9 stringtables.

Audited k2_x64.dll CHostClient::ProcessCurrentSnapshot (0x8d7c20 client, 0x89ab80 server): verified no server-backed full-snapshot retransmit exists and m_yStateSequence (+0x88a8) is mutated only by NETCMD_STATE_STRING/BLOCK (0x8d9031/0x8d95e9). Installed O(1) main-thread-checked SEH-guarded telemetry hook emitting rate-limited [NATIVE-GUARD][SNAPSHOT-DESYNC] alerts and incrementing SnapshotDesyncDropCount across >= 2 consecutive uint8_t mismatch frames without poking +0x88a8 or disabling cl_RejectDesyncedSnapshots.

limitations_and_unknowns.triangulation_notes: Dynamically verified via native_guard_unit_tests.exe (Win64 SEH + 128B K2IBufferLayout swap + CPacket read clamp + SnapshotDesyncTracker) and Linux x86_64 Docker runtime harness (linux_queue_arcade_tests + run_linux_server_docker_smoke.ps1).

indirect_calls.rationale: IGame::BroadcastGameData virtual call (vtable+0x200) resolves deterministically to CGameServer::BroadcastGameData (game_x64.dll+0x50f30 / game-x86_64-server.so+0x0012f260), guarded at concrete target entry.

counterevidence_searched: Swept all 139 IBuffer constructor sites (IAT 0x648308) in game_shared_x64.dll and inspected FUN_1804f3e00 (0x4f3e00/0x4f4b30) for any other 12+4*teamSize CBufferFixed overflows: none found outside KillNotifyHelper (0x5758e1). Verified game_x64.dll+0x51130 is string/chat broadcast rather than IBuffer packet emission. Verified k2_x64.dll CHostClient has no client-to-server full-snapshot retransmit opcode.
negative_control: Valid 28-byte kill4 (numAssists == 4) and non-0x60 opcodes remain unmodified by Stage 1A ClampKillMessageBufferInPlace and GuardClientKillMessagePacketRead; single-frame state-sequence jitter and uint8_t 255->0 wraparound do not trigger SnapshotDesyncTracker false positives; +0x88a8 and cl_RejectDesyncedSnapshots remain untouched.
notes: Stage 1A write/read clamp, Stage 1B 128B expansion (up to 29 assists), Layer 2 modular uint8_t desync telemetry, and Layer 3 kill5..kill9 localized stringtables implemented across Windows PE and Linux ELF.
